SUPPLIED CAPGEMINI FRAMEWORK · 2026 DECK

The Exceller assessment
at a glance.

This map records what the supplied Capgemini Exceller Assessment Framework presentation explicitly states. It keeps confirmed facts separate from configurable practice.

Important: The deck says a few stages are eliminatory. Candidates must clear each required stage to progress. Assessments 2–5 may be attempted in one sitting after clearance in elimination rounds. Your invitation and assessment portal take priority for your drive.
01

ENGLISH COMMUNICATION

Listening, speaking, reading and writing

The deck confirms all four skill areas. It does not give a question count or duration, so any communication-drill timing is configurable practice.

Confirmed scope
02

TECHNICAL MODULE

40 MCQs in about 45 minutes

Two 20-question sections: AI Literacy and Technical Assessment. Topics include GenAI, prompts, RAG, agents, validation, programming logic, DSA, OOP, DBMS/SQL, APIs, cloud, networking, security, Agile, DevOps and Docker awareness.

Confirmed format
03

DEBUGGING ASSESSMENT

One code-fix task in about 20 minutes

Supported languages: C, C++, and Java. Core method: Review, Identify, Fix, Validate. The deck names Trees, Graphs, 2D Dynamic Programming, and Advanced DSA as key concepts.

Confirmed format
04

AI-ASSISTED CODING

Demonstrate your process with AI

Evaluation focuses on AI literacy, prompt quality, problem-solving, and review/adaptation. The deck stresses clear inputs, edge cases, constraints, independent work, and checking generated code before submission.

Confirmed evaluation
05

COGNITIVE ASSESSMENT

Four distinct capability checks

Motion Challenge: complex planning and problem solving (6 min). Grid Challenge: working memory and spatial attention (12 min). Logical Reasoning: decisions, analysis, systems thinking (~25 min). Behavioural Module: adaptive personality assessment (25 min).

The platform will cover logical reasoning and workplace judgement. It does not reproduce Motion or Grid Challenge games in this scope.

Confirmed timings
